title: Status
description: The daemon's question about a dispatch, asked after a restart instead of dispatching again. The file holds two documents: the request at #/definitions/request and the answer at #/definitions/answer. On unknown, the daemon dispatches again under the same dispatch id.

request.title: Status request
request.description: The dispatch the daemon asks about.

dispatchId.description: The id of the dispatch, as the dispatch request carried it.

answer.title: Status answer
answer.description: Where the dispatch stands: running with optional progress text, done with a result, paused with a reason and a lever, or unknown to the module.

running.description: The step is still going on.

progress.description: Free text about how far the step has got, shown to a person and never routed on.

done.description: The step finished, whatever its verdict.

paused.description: The step stopped the flow run to wait for a person.

reason.description: Why the flow run is paused, shown to a person.

lever.description: What a person acts on to resume the flow run.

unknown.description: The module does not know the dispatch, so the daemon dispatches the step again under the same id.

result.description: The step's result document, which the flow's routes read. It carries a verdict; the rest is the step's declared result schema, so it is left open here.

verdict.description: The value the flow's routes read.
